messages.subject: stacked area chart(again)
parts:
I'm trying to do a stacked area chart. Below is the code and
source data. I can't seem to attache the plot image. I'm apparently
not doing something quite right. R seems to be quite the tool but
I've not had the epiphany that makes all this clear yet. Also,
any recommended reference tomes would be appreciated. My focus
is performing performance analysis on database metrics.

here's the code:

library(ggplot2)
datum<-read.table("mytestdata.csv",
header = TRUE,flush=TRUE,sep=",",stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
attach(datum)
ggplot(datum,aes(as.POSIXct(SAMPL,tz="","%H:%M"),WAITING,fill=EVENT))
+geom_area()
